blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Silver Valley fell from 15 in June to 13 in October (−13.3%), and 12 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 4.9% of Maple Ridge’s 268 condos and townhomes listed.

items.t: ALR bar on stratification: ALR status is per-parcel in this part of Maple Ridge. Where a parcel is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, its residences cannot be stratified — ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6, Strata Property Act s. 239 and Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1) — which is one reason the sub-area's large-lot edge produces freehold houses, not strata product. Check the Agricultural Land Commission's mapping for any specific lot.

blocks.text: Silver Valley home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

24 townhomes sold in Silver Valley with a median price of $805,000 (the middle half sold between $756,250 and $879,900), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 98.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $510 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median strata fee of $367 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 condos and townhomes listed in Silver Valley. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Silver Valley?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Silver Valley had a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Silver Valley a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 12 condos and townhomes sold in Silver Valley over those 5 months, out of 230 in all of Maple Ridge.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Silver Valley from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?

faq.a: None verified. A buyer searching "Silver Valley condos" is shopping townhouses north of the Alouette River.
faq.q: Are there any apartment condos in Silver Valley?

faq.a: It recorded 15 Condos & Townhomes listings and no sale (ratio NA) — an untested shelf that month. SnapStats publishes no Silver Valley median and no townhome-only split; the Maple Ridge community attached median ($525,000) is context, not a Silver Valley figure.
faq.q: How did Silver Valley's attached market do in September 2026?

faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC, and Brighton's building record records rentals as allowed. Short-term rentals can still be restricted; check the registered bylaws on the Form B.
faq.q: Can I rent out a townhome at Brighton or Windfall long-term?

faq.a: One current Windfall listing record states pets allowed with restrictions for that complex.
faq.q: Are pets allowed in the Silver Valley townhome complexes?

faq.a: Brighton is 2011 (145 units, Portrait Homes), Archstone Rockridge's year is in conflict between listings, Hillside Homes was expected to complete in 2022, and Windfall is 2023 (54 units). For the 2011 stock, the depreciation report is the document that shows upcoming roof and envelope work.
faq.q: How old is the townhome stock?

faq.a: None verified — Maple Ridge has zero verified 55+ strata townhouses.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Silver Valley sell for?
faq.a: 24 townhomes sold in Silver Valley between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $805,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Silver Valley?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.8% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
